inv.desc_es:
Magnifico restaurante de 300 m2 distribuidos en dos plantas 200m en planta y 100 metros en sótano, donde encontramos una bodega, cámara frio, vestuario y baño. cuenta con con un aforo de 100 comensales. Licencia C3, El local no tiene terraza ni posibilidad al estar en la conocida calle Ferran, en el barrio Gótico. Cuenta con una planta principal a pie de calle con 2 comedores, así como un sótano con 5 lavabos y almacén.
Dispone de 2 cocinas, una de ellas a la vista con salida de humos y un horno, el local cuenta con un altillo que actualmente se utiliza de almacén.
El restaurante esta totalmente reformado y equipado.

Alquiler: 11000€ + IVA con contrato de 10 años
Traspaso: 400000€
Fianza de Incasol: 2 meses, a valorar garantía adicional

inv.desc_en:
Magnificent 300 m2 restaurant distributed over two floors, 200 m on the ground floor and 100 meters in the basement, where we find a cellar, cold room, changing room and bathroom. It has a capacity for 100 diners. License C3, The premises do not have a terrace or possibility as it is located in the well-known Ferran street, in the Gothic quarter. It has a main floor at street level with 2 dining rooms, as well as a basement with 5 toilets and a warehouse.
It has 2 kitchens, one of them in sight with smoke outlet and an oven, the premises have a loft that is currently used as a warehouse.
The restaurant is completely renovated and equipped.

Rent: €11,000 + VAT with a 10-year contract
Transfer: €400,000
Incasol deposit: 2 months, additional guarantee to be assessed

If you want more information, do not hesitate to contact us
